contexts.text: Sarai was barren, she had no offspring () = that evil and falsity produced themselves no more.
Sarai as a wife = truth to be adjoined to the Celestial; Sarai as a sister = intellectual truth. AC 1468.
Sarai () = truth.
That Sarai a wife = the truth adjoined to the celestial things which were with the Lord. Explained. AC 1489.
Sarai the wife of Abram did not bear to him () = that as yet there was no rational man.
Sarai = truth adjoined to good. AC 1895. AC 1898. AC 1911.

Sarai = intellectual truth which as a wife has been adjoined to good. Intellectual truth... is like a mother without offspring when as yet there is no Rational, into which and through which it may inflow... This intellectual truth represented by Sarai is the Spiritual itself which inflows through Heaven...
As the Rational cannot come forth except also through the influx of the intellectual truth represented by Sarai...
Sarai, Abram's wife, took () = the affection of truth, which, in the genuine sense, is Sarai the wife; (for) Sarai = truth adjoined to good; and a wife = affection. AC 1907. AC 1913.
These things were said to Sarai, by whom is represented intellectual truth, which the Lord Himself had, and from which He thought...
What, in special, is signified by Sarai; by Sarai as a wife, and by Sarai as a mistress, cannot be described...
(Why Sarai was changed to Sarah. See Abraham.)
Sarai thy wife () = truth conjoined with good. Sarai = intellectual truth; and, as wife is here added, she = this truth conjoined with good.

Thou shalt not call her name Sarai, for Sarah is her name () = that He will put off the human, and will put on the Divine... For the letter H, which was added in the name Sarah, was taken from the name Jehovah, in order that Sarah, like Abraham, should represent the Lord's Divine; namely, the Divine marriage of good with truth in the Lord; Abraham, the Divine good, and Sarah, the Divine truth, from which should be born the Divine Rational.

The truth which was to be conjoined with the Divine good, was represented by Sarai, and which, when made Divine, is represented by Sarah... The truth not as yet Divine, represented by Sarai, was not as yet so united to good as to be truth from good.
For by Sarah is represented... the truth of good, which is intellectual truth.
By Sarah is signified the Divine truth which the Lord had. AC 2069:3.
Shall Sarah a daughter of ninety years bear? () = that truth conjoined with goodwill do this; (for) Sarah = truth conjoined with good, or truth Divine.
Sarah = Divine truth conjoined with Divine good. AC 2093.
The truth itself represented by Sarah was of the internal man, thus was Divine.
That Sarah is here the Lord as to truth, is evident from the representation of Sarah, which is intellectual truth adjoined to good; here, rational; truth. Explained.
Where is Sarah thy wife? () = rational truth, which then did not appear, because it was in rational good. Explained.
A son for Sarah thy wife ()... Sarah = rational truth.
Sarah heard at the door of the tent () = that rational truth was then near what is holy.
Sarah represents the Lord as to rational truth ... thus both (she and Abraham) here represent the Human with the Lord.
It ceased to be with Sarah as is the way of women () = that it could no longer remain thus.
Sarah laughed within herself () = the affection of that rational truth in regard to its being so done. AC 2203, Explained. AC 2207.
Sarah = rational truth. AC 2207.
A son for Sarah = the Divine Rational about to be.
The rational truth represented by Sarah could not comprehend (this). Signified.

The state of the human Rational with the Lord is described by Sarah's laughing; and thereby is signified with what affection the truth of the Rational, then separated from good, regarded that which was said: that it should be put off, and the Divine put on... It perceived from the Divine of what quality it still was, and how much of the human there was still in it, which it should expel. This is signified by the laughing of Sarah.

Sarah his wife () = spiritual truth conjoined with the Celestial; (for) Sarah a wife = intellectual truth conjoined with Divine good; or, what is the same, spiritual truth conjoined with the Celestial. References. AC 2558. AC 2569. AC 2588.
(Abimelech) regarded Sarah... as Abraham's sister; and by Sarah as a sister is signified rational truth. AC 2556. AC 2587.
Sarah a wife = spiritual truth... And as Sarah = Divine spiritual truth, the doctrine itself of true faith is also meant by Sarah a wife; for doctrine is from truths.
Sarah as a sister = what is rational.
Sarah from a sister made a wife = spiritual truth conjoined with the Celestial by means of rationality.
Sarah as a wife = Divine spiritual truth.
Jehovah visited Sarah () = the presence of the Divine Celestial in the Divine Spiritual... Sarah = the Divine Spiritual, that is, the Divine truth. AC 2639. AC 2643. AC 2651.
Whom Sarah bare to him () = the esse and existere from the Divine Spiritual united to the Divine Celestial.
In all that Sarah saith unto thee, hearken unto her voice () = that He should act according to spiritual truth, Sarah = the Divine Spiritual, or Divine truth.
Sarah, here () = the truth Divine which expired.
The lives of Sarah were () = the times and states of the Church as to the truths Divine which had preceded.

Sarah, when she lived as a wife with Abraham, represented the Lord's Divine truth conjoined with His Divine good... and, as she = the Lord's Divine truth, she also = the truth Divine of the Church; for in the Church there is no other truth than that which is the Lord's.
The years of the lives of Sarah () = while any truth Divine remained. The lives of Sarah = the states as to truth Divine.
Sarah died () = night as to the truths of faith... Sarah = truth Divine. AC 2910.
Abraham buried Sarah his wife () = that they received from the Lord truth conjoined with good... Sarah as a wife = truth conjoined with good.
Sarah (as the mother of Isaac) = the Divine truth.

Isaac introduced her into the tent of Sarah his mother () = the sanctuary of truth in the Divine Human... Sarah the mother = truth Divine, from which was born the Divine Human, the Rational of which is represented by her son Isaac.
Abraham and Sarah represented the Lord as to the Divine Celestial... Explained.
By Sarah is represented the Lord's Divine truth.
